operations.build: Build one remote package or local PKGBUILD root without saving a preference
operations.upgrade: Run the source-aware system update and apply saved source-build preferences
operations.upgrade-aur: Update only installed AUR packages while applying saved source-build preferences
operations.upgrade-all: Run the full source-aware repository, configured-source, and remaining-AUR update
operations.deps: Classify AUR dependencies for one or more packages
operations.plan: Show the AUR build-order plan for one or more packages
operations.fetch: Fetch AUR build repositories without updating working trees
operations.add-src: Enable source-build preferences for one or more items
operations.del-src: Remove one or more source-build preferences
operations.revert: Remove preferences and reinstall binary packages
operations.edit-src: Edit one or more source-build preferences
operations.-G: Export one AUR PackageBase repository without building or installing
operations.-Gp: Print one AUR PackageBase PKGBUILD without keeping a checkout
operations.-Syu: Update repository packages and normal installed AUR packages without saved source-build preferences
operations.-Su: Update repository packages and normal installed AUR packages without refreshing sync databases or using saved source-build preferences
operations.add-patch: Register ordered PKGBUILD patch references for one local source; never auto-apply
operations.update-patch: Explicitly update a local patch association, order and expected digests
operations.del-patch: Forget a local patch association without deleting user material
operations.list-patch: List saved patch associations without checking external material

options.--details: Show detailed diagnostic and provenance information for remote build, plan, deps, -S --select, -Qua, -Syu/-Su, upgrade-aur/all, --dry-run -S, and list-patch; presentation only
options.-h: Show the help message and exit
options.--help: Show the help message and exit
options.--dry-run: Observe a supported mutating operation without changing persistent state
options.--edit: Open or edit PKGBUILD and .install files for this invocation
options.--diff: Review repository updates; for AUR, review the exact target from the previous reviewed revision or all tracked source initially
options.--nodiff: Skip repository diff / reviewed-source review without advancing reviewed state
options.--noconfirm: Skip prompts on supported routes; forwarding remains route-owned
options.--rmdeps: Preview newly installed build dependencies after remote AUR build success; remove only with explicit approval
options.--local: Use one local PKGBUILD directory as the build root
options.--use-preference: Use the saved source-build preference for one remote build; conflicts with V=K assignments
options.--output-dir: Select an existing export parent for -G
options.--select: Interactively select source-aware package candidates for plain -S
options.--aur: Limit supported sync operations to AUR
options.--repo: Use only official binary repositories; with -Syu / -Su, run the repository system upgrade only
options.--needed: Preserve pacman --needed semantics at the installation phase owned by the selected route
options.--use-patches: Explicitly select saved recipe patches for build --local; requires metadata evaluation consent
